hero_kpi_rationale: The Global Business Solutions segment, focused on cloud (QuickBooks Online, Mailchimp), represents 59% of total revenue and displays double-digit growth, driven by cloud platform adoption for small and medium-sized businesses, a structural trend amplified by growing AI integration in financial and marketing tools.

kpis.name: Global Business Solutions segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from cloud offerings for small and medium-sized businesses (QuickBooks Online, Mailchimp, etc.).
kpis.description: The Global Business Solutions segment, renamed in August 2024, consolidates the company's key cloud offerings. It generated 11.1 billion dollars in revenue in 2025, up 16% year-over-year.
kpis.signal: Solid growth in the cloud segment, the primary revenue driver.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately 80.5% in 2025, improving versus prior years, driven by scale benefits on service costs and the ramp-up of the SaaS model.
kpis.signal: High gross margin, typical for cloud software publishers.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Increased from 22.3% in 2024 (3.630 billion dollars / 16.285 billion dollars) to 26.1% in 2025 (4.923 billion dollars / 18.831 billion dollars), driven by revenue growth and disciplined cost management despite marketing and headcount investments.

kpis.name: R&D expenses as percentage of revenue
kpis.explanation: Research and development spending divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: R&D expenses increase in absolute terms, but their share of revenue declines to 12.5% in 2025 versus 13.3% in 2024, reflecting disciplined spending prioritization despite ongoing investments in AI and cloud technologies.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in R&D/revenue ratio despite absolute spending increase.

kpis.name: Capex investments
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets intended to improve productive capacity.
kpis.description: Estimated at approximately 1.1 billion dollars in 2025, growing 10%, primarily directed toward cloud platforms, cybersecurity, and customer experience.
kpis.signal: Capex on the rise, supported by cloud infrastructure and security requirements.

kpis.name: Recurring service revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenue from subscriptions and associated services from the Global Business Solutions segment.
kpis.description: The Global Business Solutions segment service revenue reaches 9.3 billion dollars in 2025, up 19.6%, driven by QuickBooks Online, Mailchimp, and associated services.
kpis.signal: Robust recurring revenue growth, the cornerstone of SaaS valuation.

kpis.name: Total headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Intuit continues to hire selectively, notably in product, technology, and customer support functions, bringing headcount to approximately 15,500 employees in 2025.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth reflecting disciplined cost management.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets sourced from yfinance over the last four fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 36.96 billion euros in the latest year.

kpis.name: Dividends per share
kpis.description: Annual dividends per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven declared fiscal years by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividends per share of 2.4 dollars in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last four declared fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders through dividends of 1.189 billion dollars in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio: Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 30.7% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, values sourced from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight declared fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 18.831 billion dollars in the latest year.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.description: Consolidated annual net income, values sourced from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight declared fiscal years 10-K filings.
kpis.signal: Net income of 3.869 billion dollars in the latest year.

kpis.name: Credit Karma revenue growth
kpis.explanation: Annual revenue growth for the Credit Karma segment.
kpis.description: Credit Karma revenue increases 32% in 2025, driven by demand for digital financial services and integration with the Intuit ecosystem, notably through verticals such as personal loans, credit cards, and auto insurance.
kpis.signal: Strong acceleration driven by personal loans and credit cards.

ai_positioning.summary: AI is progressively integrated into Intuit's product ecosystem. The 10-K filings mention growing AI integration in financial and marketing tools, notably through AI assistants in QuickBooks and automated recommendations in Mailchimp, although without specific quantified details on adoption or revenue contribution.
evidence: Integration mentioned in Global Business Solutions product strategy
